title: P's snapshot/restore leaves a placed, unwired cap on disk when the process dies or the file is held between placement and restore
scenario_script: pr57pt/probe-composite/c03_restore_failure.py (cases A2, A7; uses locker.py), c04_crash_windows.py (+ c04_child.py), c08_window_timing.py, c00_lock_semantics.py
verifier_method: Rebuilt independently with external actors and no hooks inside B/P/M: v02_crash_hold.py runs each call in a child process (v02_child.py); this process polls the sheet's (size, mtime) without sleeping and on the k-th change either TerminateProcess-kills the child or opens a plain read handle for 3 s. Controls: C0 (a read handle in another process blocks os.replace, WinError 5) and C1 (poller alone, all calls complete). Also v03 R1/R2 and v07 OK-1. kicad-cli 9.0.8 nets_coded on every end state; KiCad's tiny_tapeout demo (1.17 MB) for the window. Scripts and .out in pr57pt/verify-probe-composite/.

title: P lets the cap's own placement join existing parts to VCC/GND and reports them as 'already wired'
verifier_method: v01_placement_contacts.py S1/S2 on my own geometry (Device:C at (152.4,127); S1 an unnamed R5 placed exactly under it, S2 a dangling wire end from R5:1 at C1:1's landing point), run through B, P and M. kicad-cli 9.0.8 nets before and after, compared per pre-existing pin as well as by harness.diff.

title: P's kept auto-junction lands on an unsplit power rail and kicad-cli 9 drops a far-side pin from VCC
verifier_method: v01_placement_contacts.py S3/S3r/S3n/S4 with pre-split fixtures, through B, P and M. Junctions inside unsplit wires were detected geometrically. Each result was exported a second time from a copy split at every interior junction (my own splitter; the GUI/K10 shape per sourced digest G06/G18). Read pcb.py:1880-1910.

title: P keeps the cap's hard-coded up/down: at rotation 180 stubs and labels land inside the symbol
verifier_method: v04_rotations.py: Device:C and Device:C_Small at 0/90/180/270 on a loose sheet, plus rotation 180 on a sub-sheet, through B, P and M. Geometry from my own integer KiCad transform (rotate, then mirror), cross-checked in every run: each computed pin end is the start of a stub or carries a label. kicad-cli nets for every run.

title: On a sub-sheet, P's cap lands on sheet-local /kid/VCC and /kid/GND instead of the project rails, reported as wired to VCC/GND
verifier_method: v05_subsheet_names.py: project root with power:VCC and power:GND on R1; cap placed on a child sheet. Cases: K1 (child has no power symbols), K2 (child has power:GND), K3 (R7:1 already wired to a local VCC on the child, then the cap), K0 (root control). Through B, P and M; kicad-cli root export; kicad-cli ERC on the root for K1/K3.

title: P prototype's restore stops at the first failing file and ignores KeyboardInterrupt
verifier_method: Code read of proposal_impl.py:940-946 (_restore loops over files with no try and raises on the first failure) and :988 (except Exception). v03_restore_semantics.py R1/R2 with external holds, no hooks.

title: P's restore-to-snapshot silently discards an edit another writer made during a refused call
verifier_method: v03_restore_semantics.py L1/L2/L3. A second writer in another process (this script) appends a text node through its own tmp plus os.replace when it sees P's pin-1 write (loose) or P's root-index write (sub-sheet). Pin 2 lands on global FOO, so P refuses and restores. M is the control.
